Watching him wear this jersey for the last time feels unreal. When the clock hit the 10th minute and the whole stadium stopped to applaud him, when everyone stood up chanting his name, I realized this was truly the end of an era. This wasn't just a player retiring, this was our childhood, our history walking off the pitch. From his debut in 2005 to 207 caps, 125 goals, from the heartbreaks to finally lifting the World Cup in 2022 and two Copa Americas, he gave us everything. He carried the weight of an entire nation for 21 years and never stopped giving his all. Thank you, Messi, for everything you've brought to Argentina. You will never be replaced. The number 10 will always be yours. #leomessi #lionelmessi #messi #argentina #foryou
